# CITY OF MEADOWBROOK PLANNING COMMISSION NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING Case No.: ZC-2026-0418 Hearing: Thursday, April 23, 2026, 7:00 PM Location: Council Chambers, 200 Civic Plaza NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Planning Commission of the City of Meadowbrook will hold a public hearing to consider an application to rezone approximately 12.4 acres from R-1 (Single-Family Residential) to R-3 (Multi-Family Residential). The subject property is on the east side of Alder Court, between Linden Way and Harbor Road, and is identified as follows: Parcel 10 14-201-007 Parcel TO 34-203.008 Interested persons may appear at the hearing or send written comments to the Planning Division no later than 5:00 PM on Tuesday, April 21, 2026, by mail to 200 Civic Plaza, Meadowbrook, or by e-mail to planning@meadowbrook.example. Dated: March 30, 2026 Teresa Nowak, City Clerk STAFF REPORT SUMMARY - CASE ZC-2026-0418
Item Current Proposed
Zoning district R-1 R-3
Maximum density 4 du/acre 18 du/acre
Maximum height 35 ft 45 ft
Parking per unit 2.0 1.5
Staff recommends approval subject to three conditions: (1) a traffic study before any building permit is issued; (2) a 30-foot landscaped buffer along the western property line; and (3) stormwater detention sized for a 25-year storm. The applicant has held two neighborhood meetings. Minutes of both meetings are on file with the Planning Division and are available on request. Dated: March 30, 2026 Teresa Nowak, City Clerk
